title: Parking License Payments, Replacement Vehicles and Changes of Space
content:
Training note on three Parking License subjects: payments toward the parking balance, registering a replacement vehicle, and moving to another space or another product.

**When are parking payments accepted?** Parking payments are accepted while the license is active, suspended, notice-given or terminated, as the status on the license record shows.

**Which charge does a payment pay?** A payment is applied to the oldest open parking charge first. *Hypothetical example:* open charges of $12.40 (posted 3 April) and $95.00 (posted 1 May) and a payment of $50.00 — the April charge is paid in full and $37.60 goes to the May charge.

**When is the security deposit applied to parking?** Deposit application is used only at final accounting.

**Can a resident register a new car on the license?** A replacement vehicle is registered only under the same vehicle rules as at assignment — the product's registration, size and vehicle-kind requirements.

**What does a move to another space cost?** A move to another space of the same product bills the product's space move charge.

**What about changing to a different parking product?** A change of product is a new request for that product, joining its waitlist, and the old license ends when the new one starts.
